answer_1.quote: the goal of dense video captioning is to generate captions and temporal locations for a series of moments simultaneously... We leverage the paragraph caption of the target video as the prediction... Our method can be leveraged to automatically generate captions for internet videos.
answer_1.outputs: captions describing video events and temporal locations

answer_2.quote: For video paragraph captioning, we use commonly-adopted metrics CIDEr (C) and METEOR... As to dense video captioning... SODA_c (S) is also used to measure the temporal coherence...
